architectural_determination: The existing shadow path is real and productively wired, but its observable records do not expose the complete causal semantics of H1 or H3. Because no read-only adapter can recover semantics that are absent from the records, H1/H3 must be excluded from HCPDQ-v2 rather than creating benchmark-specific production observability.

rationale: Ordinary runtime turns do invoke the existing shadow planner.
The shadow exposes intent, needs, tools, evidence, policy and decision-context observability.
H1 requires deterministic reasoning-path semantics, but the shadow plan is advisory and does not expose stage-specific reasoning execution or a causal reasoning-path outcome.
Using shadow plan metadata as H1 would overclaim observability.
Ordinary runtime turns populate shadow planning observations.
Existing runtime paths also observe selected conversation context and governed capability selection.
Those assessors compare planned versus selected context/capability, but they do not expose the semantic negation, quoted-span and distractor evidence required for complete H3 certification.
Creating benchmark semantic labels would cross the evaluation boundary.
